comment: steal.c steal() 444: a debug Tourist wears a wished cloak over her Hawaiian shirt and drops everything else (D, all types), so the only stealable items are the worn shirt and cloak. A nymph created next to her (^G) is woken with F and charms her; when the random pick is the shirt, the worn cloak is taken instead (444). Seven searches before ^G set the timing for that pick; earlier timings picked the cloak itself.
